# The Live TV

> > The Live TV: A platform focused on medical imaging technology, particularly advanced MRI systems and diagnostic imaging innovations in healthcare.

The Live TV provides information and resources related to cutting-edge medical imaging technologies, including 3 Tesla MRI, 7 Tesla MRI, functional MRI (fMRI), Cardiac MRI, and Diffusion Tensor Imaging (DTI). The site covers healthcare innovation with a focus on diagnostic imaging advancements in the United States and India.

## Key Topics

- MRI Technology
- 3 Tesla MRI
- 7 Tesla MRI
- Functional MRI (fMRI)
- Cardiac MRI
- Diffusion Tensor Imaging (DTI)
- CT Scanners
- Diagnostic Imaging
- Medical Technology
- US Healthcare Innovation
- Advanced MRI Systems
- Medical Centers
- Healthcare Comparison
- United States Healthcare
- India Healthcare
